_comment: APPROVE -> the run parks -> the form must appear in chat.
The one transition nothing covered: approval_run_playbook_new stops at an
approved run that FINISHED, and manual_input_form starts at a turn that is
ALREADY parked. Neither drives approve -> resume -> form, which is where an
analyst actually gets stuck: if the form never renders, the run sits on the
box waiting for input nobody can give it.
